title: Zesty Smoke Hot Korean Baked Beans Patbingsu
description: A sweet and silky Korean dish featuring baked beans in a smoky and spicy patbingsu form, perfect for a comforting meal. This plant-based friendly recipe combines the flavors of Korea with the comfort of baked beans.

ingredients.name: fruit
ingredients.notes: such as strawberries, blueberries, or bananas

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and smoked paprika.
Add the canned baked beans to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the bean mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
While the beans are baking, prepare the patbingsu toppings by cutting the mochi into small pieces and washing the fruit.
Remove the beans from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the patbingsu, place a scoop of the baked beans in a bowl, followed by a spoonful of crushed ice, some mochi pieces, and a selection of fruit.
Drizzle any remaining sauce from the bean mixture over the top of the patbingsu and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
